item.title: PK parameter model
item.description:
PK parameter model

Consider the following extension of the population model from introduction. Each of 59 neonates was given some loading dose of the drug, had a plasma drug level measured about 2 hours later, was given maintenance doses about every 12 hours thereafter, had possibly one trough level measured during maintenance dosing, and certainly one level measured some time after the last maintenance dose. Due to the long half-life of the drug, for the purposes of analysis all doses can be regarded as intravenous bolus doses. The weight and APGAR score of each individual are available as concomitant information. The APGAR score (1-10) is a measure of a neonate’s health at birth.

item.title: General linear model
item.description: Recall that NONMEM supports general linear ODE model $$ \frac{dA(t)}{dt}=K^TA(t). $$ Here \(K\) is a \(n\times n\) matrix that could depend on \(x\). \(K_{ij}\) \((i, j)\) entry of \(K\), quantifies the first-order distribution of drug from compartment number i to compartment number j. NONMEM provides ADVAN5 and ADVAN7 for this type of model. In particular, ADVAN7 targets problems in which \(K\) has real eigenvalues, suitable for most PK applications.

item.title: Michaelis–Menten model
item.description:
ODE solution of Michaelis–Menten model

NONMEM AVDAN10 supports one-compartment model with Michaelis-Menten (M-M) elimination. For M-M kinetics in other compartment models, user will need to utilize general nonlinear models for numerical ODE solution. item.title: PKPD model
item.description:
PKPD model

PKPD model can be performed either sequentially or simultaneously. Let us first consider sequential models in which PD is based on PK results.

PK/PD sequentially modeled

Assume a previous PK model run provides elimination rate constant and volume of distribution prediction as data item KK and V1, then we can use them in the Emax PD model with an effect compartment. We see the virtual effect compartment acts just like the peripheral compartment in two-compartment model, so we can promptly use ADVAN3 to describe this model. The data item DV from the data set is for the effect observations.
